title: ATP Protocol Index Entry
description: Vectorable unit for RAG-based protocol retrieval. One entry per protocol.

semantic_summary.description: 2-3 sentence dense description optimized for embedding quality. Describes what the protocol covers, what tasks trigger it, and what distinguishes it from similar protocols. Do NOT paraphrase the protocol name — add semantic density.

preload_size_class.description: xs=<500 tokens, sm=<2k, md=<10k, lg=<50k, xl=>50k. Estimated total token cost of all declared vars + docs.

priority.description: Conflict resolution priority. Higher wins when multiple protocols match. Default 50.

requires_var_ids.description: IDs of variables required by this protocol

requires_doc_urls.description: URLs of documentation required by this protocol

updated_at.description: Date this entry was last regenerated
